content: अभिनिविष्ट {%<ab>p. p.</ab>%} .²1 Intent on, engrossed in, engaged in or occupied with, applying oneself to; माधवापकारं प्रति अभिनिविष्टा भवामि <ls>Māl. 6</ls>. .²2 Firmly or steadily fixed, uncontrollably fixed, steady, attentive, intent; अत्यभिनिविष्टवित्तदर्पस्य <ls>Dk. 29</ls>; <ls>Māl. 1</ls>. .²3 Endowed with, possessed of; गुरुभिरभिनिविष्टम् (गर्भम्) लोकपालानुभावैः <ls>R. 2. 75</ls>. .²4 Determined, resolute, persevering. .²5 (In a bad sense) Obstinate, perverse; अथवाभिनिविष्टबुद्धिषु व्रजति व्यर्थकतां सुभाषितम् <ls>Śi. 16. 43</ls>; <ls>Ki. 17. 11</ls>. .²6 Well-versed or proficient in. .{@-ष्टम्@} Perseverance.
